translations.settingGroup.title: Title
translations.setting.scale.help: How big the text is. "Auto" fills the page as far as it can — a fixed number may overflow it.
translations.setting.columns.help: Split the song into columns so a long one still fits a single page.
translations.setting.aspectRatio.help: The shape of the page. Crop it to your content to waste less space — printing keeps the shape and scales to fit. Custom accepts a ratio like 3:4, a fraction like 3/4, or a number.
translations.settings.error.ratio: Use a ratio like 3:4, a fraction like 3/4, a number, or A4.
translations.setting.padding.help: The white border between the song and the edge of the page. Measured in text sizes, so it stays in proportion however big the song is printed. A songbook's print margin is added on top of this.
translations.setting.contentX.help: Where the song sits across the page when it does not fill the width. Left hugs the corner.
translations.setting.contentY.help: Where the song sits down the page when it does not fill the height. Top hugs the corner.
translations.setting.titleFont.help: The face the title and subtitle are set in. They always share one — they are a single title block. Everything else stays in the song's own font.
translations.setting.titlePosition.help: Across the top, or sideways up the left edge as a spine. The title block always hugs the top-left corner.
translations.setting.titleLayout.help: Whether the subtitle sits under the title or beside it.
translations.setting.chordColor.help: The colour of every chord in the song.
translations.setting.chordSize.help: Chord size relative to the lyrics.

translations.songs.tutorial:
* My first song
** A quick tour of the syntax

Verse: Put a chord in [C]brackets, right where the [G]sound changes.
It lands above the [Am]letter that follows it.

Chorus: The words before a colon become a [F]label.
A blank line starts a new [C]block.
Write \: when you want a colon that is not a label.

[C] [G] [Am] [F]

Outro: A line of nothing but chords is an instrumental,
and it renders a little larger.
